notes: Requires an Admin API key (api.usage.read scope) — a regular project key cannot call /organization/costs. Replace start_time with a real Unix timestamp. Verify the response shape against your account before relying on it; OpenAI has changed this API's structure before.

Requires an Admin API key. The extraHeaders.anthropic-version header is required by Anthropic's API on every request — the generic connector supports static extra headers alongside the auth header for exactly this reason.

KNOWN LIMITATION: Google Cloud Billing has no static-API-key endpoint — it requires OAuth2 (service account or a short-lived 'gcloud auth print-access-token'), which expires and needs manual refresh; it does not fit this connector's static-credential model. For real Gemini/Vertex AI billing, use the existing AWS/Azure/GCP cloud-account integration instead. This template is left as a documented placeholder, not a working default.

Stripe uses HTTP Basic auth with your secret key as the username and an empty password — put the secret key in the 'username' field. amount is in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents); timestamp is a Unix epoch seconds.

Twilio embeds the Account SID in the URL path itself — replace REPLACE_WITH_ACCOUNT_SID in usagePath with your real Account SID before saving. Basic auth: Account SID as username, Auth Token as the value. price is typically negative (a cost) in Twilio's own currency (see price_unit).
